text: ui-song-theme（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：为 DeepSeek Harness 提供宋韵风格的明暗主题。它在 DSH 客户端注入 theme 服务后，叠加一层可卸载恢复的主题 token，并补充浏览器焦点描边颜色。主要功能包括纸感浅色表面、松墨深色背景、草木青绿交互色、朱砂错误色、宋体标题字体及语义圆角。适合希望调整 DSH 网页视觉风格的用户；安装到 Web profile 即可使用，不需要额外配置，字体观感取决于本机字体。

ui-song-theme (DSH Web plugin): adds a reversible Song-inspired theme layer with paired light and dark colors for surfaces, text, buttons and status states. It also styles focus outlines and display fonts. Install in a Web profile; no extra settings are needed. Typography depends on local fonts.
想把 DSH 网页换成宋韵风格的配色。
有没有适用于 Web 界面的明暗主题插件？
让 DSH 的浅色界面更像纸张和暖墨的感觉。
希望深色模式使用松墨绿黑背景和浅玉色点缀。
能不能把网页按钮和焦点描边也统一成绿色系？
我想调整 DSH 的界面主题，同时保留系统明暗模式。
I want a Song-inspired light and dark theme for the DSH web client.
Can I give the DSH interface warm paper surfaces and botanical green accents?
ui-song-theme 的功能「成对明暗主题」：为大量语义界面 token 同时提供 light 和 dark 值，覆盖背景、文字、按钮、侧栏、状态色等区域。插件卸载时移除自己的主题层。
ui-song-theme 的功能「宋韵网页配色」：将浅色表面设为纸感暖色，深色表面设为松墨绿黑，并用草木青绿、浅玉色和朱砂状态色统一界面视觉。
ui-song-theme 的功能「字体、圆角与焦点样式」：设置宋体及 CJK 衬线标题字体和语义圆角，并为浏览器可聚焦控件设置主题色描边；插件卸载后会移除注入的样式。

ui-song-theme README · ui-song-theme：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A Song-inspired visual theme plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). It contributes a reversible `ThemeRuntime.overrideTokens()` layer with complete light and dark values while preserving the user's `light`, `dark`, or `system` preference.

ui-song-theme README · ui-song-theme：The light palette combines silk-paper surfaces, warm ink text, botanical gray-green interactions, and cinnabar error states. The dark palette uses pine-ink green-black surfaces with a restrained pale-jade accent. Display headings prefer installed Song and CJK serif fonts; body text keeps the Harness sans-serif stack. The layer also recasts visible legacy blue selections and the browser focus outline into the same botanical color family.

ui-song-theme README · Install：Install the repository as a bundle into a Web profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:yunfei07/ui-song-theme
dsh --profile web
```

For reproducible installations, pin a commit:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:yunfei07/ui-song-theme#<commit-sha>
```

ui-song-theme README · Install：The repository commits its `lib/` artifacts, so a GitHub installation does not need to run a package build script. The bundle adds a unique `ui-song-theme-external` client row; its `theme` service injection ensures the base dsh theme is ready before this token layer mounts. That row stacks after the Web bundle's built-in theme, and removing the external plugin restores the built-in layer.

Remove it with:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove ui-song-theme
```

ui-song-theme README · Palette：| Role | Light | Dark |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Base surface | Silk paper | Night ink |
| Primary text | Warm ink | Pale paper |
| Accent | Pine botanical green | Restrained pale jade |
| Error | Cinnabar | Light cinnabar |
| Geometry | 2 to 12 px semantic radii | Same |

Every override has paired light and dark values. Unloading the plugin removes only its layer and restores the theme below it.

pnpm check
pnpm build
pnpm pack:check

Build output is committed intentionally because dsh supports installing plugins directly from Git repositories.

ui-song-theme README · Compatibility：- Node.js `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0`
- DeepSeek Harness UI theme `>=0.1.0-rc.6 <0.2.0`
- System font availability affects exact Song glyph metrics
